question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the highlighted words in the given sentence.

His __interpretation__ of the facts was impressive.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"interpretation of the facts"** means the act of explaining or understanding the meaning of facts. (तथ्यों की व्याख्या) • **Example:** His **interpretation of the facts** was both insightful and thorough. • **"Understanding of realities"** refers to the comprehension or grasp of real situations or facts. (वास्तविकताओं की समझ) • **Example:** Her **understanding of realities** helped her navigate complex social issues. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **understands of realities** (वास्तविकताओं को समझता है): Incorrect form of the phrase. • **Example:** He understands of realities is a grammatically incorrect sentence. • **understand of realities** (वास्तविकताओं को समझना): Incorrect form of the phrase. • **Example:** To understand of realities, one must pay attention to details is a grammatically incorrect sentence. • **understood of realities** (वास्तविकताओं को समझा): Incorrect form of the phrase. • **Example:** She understood of realities is a grammatically incorrect sentence. 3b:Tc72, The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
